alpha_strategy: The selected original RGB PNGs are preserved byte-for-byte. Native shader removes flat chroma green and suppresses edge spill. Crop-local body and limb contours isolate the original paint before continuous deformation.
registration_notes: All eight actors preserve their front-view identities, body types and costumes; the full torso, pelvis, knees and both shoes are painted in true side profile, facing right.

Initial lateral sheets were rejected as rig sources because a near arm covered the torso. A second generation moved both arms backward to expose the whole painted side garment for articulation. Sheet A required a further edit to restore matching full-length jacket sleeves on the far arms of Leather and AmberJacket.

Each member has 15 crop-local landmarks, one body polygon and four manually traced limb masks. Front/back mean near/far from the camera, not left/right in the source image. In sheet A the near arm extends farther backward; in sheet B it hangs nearer the torso. Explicit pose slots must be used for this reason.
Both registered foot toe landmarks point right of their ankle. Near/front leg is the right leg in each source image.
No bitmap edits, crops, artificial upscaling or resampling were applied after imagegen. Runtime masking and continuous skinning preserve the source texture.
